༄༅/ /snyan brgyud las zab mo brda'i dbang gi cho ga bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snyan brgyud las zab mo brda'i dbang gi cho ga bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// sems kyi bung ba ma lus shor ba'i gnas// lang tsho'i mtshar mo'i me tog kun 'dzum pa// rdo rje sems dpa'i rtse dga'i 'khri shing ni// 'khor ba'i tshad gdung skyob mar phyag 'tshal lo// nges bzung gnam the'i spa bkong zhing*// thod rgal mgrin sngon snying 'dod pa// brda yis smin byed dbyar skyes rnga// pad dkar 'bad pa'i nam mkhar sgrags// 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma lhan cig skyes ma'i sgo nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pa dag la/ spros pa rgyas par brjod par bya'o// de yang*/ rtsa rgyud le'u nyer drug par/ lugs dang lugs las bzlog pa yi// pho nya rnams ni yang dag gnas// 'og dang steng gi dngos grub ster// bdag gi pho nya ma kun 'gro// pho nya ma des don kun ster// zhes sogs kyis/ gsung pa'i don lha mo bco lnga ste/ gtso mo ni de nyid kyi 'og tu/ slob dpon rnal 'byor ma nyid yin// zhes pas bstan no// de yang*/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste rnal 'byor gyi yo byad rnams mdun du brdar nas/ padma'i snod du myos byed rnam pa brgyad gang yang rung ba blug lag pa g.yas pa bkab/ oṃ zhes brjod pas de dag gi ma dag pa sbyangs/ g.yon pa bkab/ āḥzhes brjod pas zad pa med pa nam mkha'i khams khyab par 'phel/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi lnga'i bdag nyid du bsam/ mtheb srin gyis chos 'byung bris/ de'i nang du/ ha hoḥhrīḥbartsegs pa'i yi ge ha zhu bas kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ ho zhu bas dri phun sum tshogs pa/ hrīḥzhu bas ro bcud phun tshogs pa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ de phyogs bcur 'thor cing hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o// de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong la oṃ haḥdakar po/ mdzub mo la na ma hi ser po/ gung mo la swā hā hu dmar po/ srin lag la bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/

mthe'u chung la hūṃ hūṃ ho mthing ka sor mo rnams kyi steng du phaṭ haṃ ljang khu/ lag mthil padma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ mdun gyi 'dab ma nas g.yon skor du/ haṃ yauṃ sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ dkar mo/ hreṃ hriṃ ser mo/ hūṃ hūṃ ljang kha/ phaṭ phaṭ dud ka lag pa me long gi ngos ltar dang ba rgyab tu'ang gzugs brnyan snang bar bsam la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi/ oṃ haḥn ma hi swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭ haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yauṃ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags te/ mnyes te/ bde ba'i rang bzhin du zhu ba dam rdzas la thim pas/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi gang la reg pa thams cad ye shes kyi rol mor byin gyis rlob pa zhig tu gyur// me long dang po'i khar shes rab kyi rdul la sindhu ra brdal de la gser gyi smyug gus/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis chos 'byung*/ de'i dbus su zlum po sum rim bris la/ phyi pad 'dab brgyad nang ma bris pa drug sgom pa'i tshe gnyis steng 'og tu bya'o// rang skad gis bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bco lnga yig 'bru'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs te/ baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ nas sngags 'bru thams cad la mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstod/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho ྅haṃ/ zhes brjod cing padma bkor ba'i phyag rgyas mnyes par byas te/ mthar 'khyud pa'i stangs ka sngon du 'gro bas srin lag gis maṇḍal gyi sa la reg cing*/ badzra muḥzhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag nyid la bzhugs par bya'o// de nas de na gnas pa'i chang gi khu ba srin lag gis blangs nas/ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing snying ga dang lce dang spyi bor reg pas/

bdag gi sgo gsum shin tu dag par gyur/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig snyam tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi ched du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje btsun mo'i bsgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam/ de nas/ oṃ sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ zhes brjod de/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ kha dog dmar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du 'phar ma gnyis kyi phyi ma la padma 'dab ma brgyad/ nang ma la bzhi/ lte ba nas phyogs g.yon mtshams g.yas skor du/ baṃ aṃ iṃ uṃ eṃ/ steng du oṃ/ 'og tu aṃ/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha'i yi ge nyin mor byed pa'i snying po lta bu/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang*/ sems can thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus te yi ge rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bhan dhu dzi ba ka'i me tog kha bye ma thag gi mdog ltar dmar zhing dwangs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa'i zhal nas khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug pus mo'i thad du bsdigs shing g.yon thod pa bdud kyi and+ra dang khrag gis gang ba g.yon gyi nam mkhar phyogs pa'i zhal du gsol ba/ rdo rje kha ṭāṃ ga dkar po phrag g.yon du bkal ba/ skra grol zhing mi mgo skam po lnga'i cod pan dang*/ rlon pa brgya'i phyed kyi do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/

rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ dum bu'i ska rags te/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ gcer mo brgyad gnyis kyi lang tsho'i dpyid/ nu ma 'phrang zhing 'bur ba/ stod yangs pa/ sked pa phra ba/ bha ga rgyas pa/ smad sbom pa/ glang po che'i sna lta bu'i zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mo mnan pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i 'od zer can/ steng du mkha' la spyod pa'i rje btsun ma dkar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa bsnams te mkha' la 'phur ba/ 'og tu sa 'og tu spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ma nag mo dur phag khros pa'i gdong la spyan gsum dmar la 'khrugs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje sdigs mdzub kyis gdon thams cad gzir ba/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad sbrul gdug pas byas pa/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ phyi'i shar du khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje mche ba mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo bcu gnyis phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ thams cad gcer mo skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i 'phreng ba can g.yas brkyang gis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ khor yug tu zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'o// gtso 'khor de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ gtso mo'i lte bar oṃ baṃ phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yauṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ khar hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/

dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ tsaṇḍi ka dud kha/ mig la gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar sgra rdo rje ma/ sna la dri rdo rje ma/ lce la ro rdo rje ma/ lus la reg bya rdo rje ma/ yid la chos kyi rdo rje ma/ lha mo de thams cad gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i bha gar chos 'byung la yi ge'i tshogs bkod pa/ baṃ yig gi mthar snying pos bskor ba dmar lhag ge ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing nas chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ longs sku dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro/ sprul sku za byed mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag bskyed dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod par mdzad pas lus ngag yid ye shes kyi sgrib pa dag dbang bzhi thob/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun spyi bor lud pas/ gtso mo dang mkha' spyod ma la rnam snang*/ sa 'og ma la mi skyod pa/ phyogs ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ sgo ma bzhi la snang ba mtha' yas/ mtshams ma bzhi la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas nyer mchod lnga/ rig ma bcu drug bdud rtsi myang ba/ sngags 'khyud stangs rnams byas te/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan zhugs tshangs sogs dbang byed las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmongs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod de/

lha'i 'khor lo de 'ja' tshon gyi snang ba tsam du gsal gdab ste/ ji tsam nus par bsgom mo// de las sun na rdzogs pa'i rim pa la 'jug ste/ srin zhal drag tu bsdams te 'og rlung gyen la 'then pas lha mo'i bha ga sngags kyi 'khor lo 'bar rab tu 'bar bas chags pa rgyas pa'i me lces rtsa thams cad bsregs pa rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo/ de nas 'khor lo de g.yon du rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo bzhin drag tu 'khor ba bde chen gsung gi rin chen/ de las ngal na me long la has btab pa 'du ba ltar dmigs pa nye bar bsdus te stong pa nyid la ma yengs par bzhag pa rang grol phyag rgya chen po'o// de las du ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma mthong na bzung bar bya ba de la 'dzin pa rang rig gi sems bkod de bzhag pas bzung 'dzin ro snyoms pa spyod pa chu la ral gri rgyab pa'o// de las gdod ma nas gnas pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang du 'byams klas ste de ni rig pa ye shes kyi sgron ma'o// de las gzhan gyi don la rtag tu mi 'da' ba ni dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma lde ba ste/ gal te khams 'du bas gegs su gyur nas grang ba la gtum mo'i me sbar ba dang*/ tshad pa la me lces haṃ zhu ba'i rgyun gyis lus gang ba dang*/ 'dus pa la 'bar 'dzag 'thab pa de bzhin 'og steng kha sbyar gyi rlung dang sbyar bas ro snyoms phyi'i me long du shes par bya'o// de nas stong nyid las langs te gtso mo'i nye snying ngam snying po dang*/ lha mo rnams las sa bon bzla bar bya'o// de nas mtshan phyed la/ gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ ji skad bkod pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas dang chang bza' bca'i sha'i tshogs gtso bor bton pa'i gtor ma bsham/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ raṃ kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ la rlung dang me dang thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥlas thod pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba/ zla phyed rdo rje phyed pas kha bcad pa/

gsang ba'i baṃ las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu/ zla phyed kyi steng rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi bkug rdo rje dang zla phyed kyang zhu ba rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho tsam du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlab bo// rang gi rkang pa g.yas pa'i rgyu mas g.yon pa'i bol mnan/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te dpral ba'i thod du bskor/ lta stangs g.yon du blta/ ngag tu pheṃ zhes brjod pas/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal mo/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor blon mo/ zhing skyong gi ḍā ki ma mngag gzhug 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs 'bangs lta bus nam mkha' khyab par byon/ oṃ a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki nī sa ma yast+waṃ dṛ shya hoḥ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul bas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags rdo rje'i bu gu can gyi rnam par gsol bar gyur/ de nas/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa bcom// khyod ni dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi dpyid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// zhes pas dngos grub blang bar bya'o// sngar bzhin bsngo/ oṃ kha kha sogs kyi 'jig rten pa la gtor ma bsngo/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho ྅ haṃ/ zhes padma'i lag kor gyis mnyes par byas/ 'khyud stangs sngon du 'gro ba'i se gol brdabs te/ oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ badzra muḥ'ajig rten pa rang gnas dang*/

dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rang la bstim/ me long la has btab pa 'du ba bzhin/ snod thams cad bcud/ de thams cad chos 'byung*/ de 'khor de gtso mo/ de sngags kyi 'khor lo la/ de baṃ la de rim gyis yal ba'i stong pa nyid la bzhag ste/ slar lha mo'i glus bskul bar bsams nas ldang*/ dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis brjod par bya'o// mar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu 'am/ yar gyi ngo la'ang rung ste/ sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pas bskor/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshams/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshe brda'i chas rnams kyang brdar ro// bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas nas/ de nas rten dkyil 'khor swa bhā was sbyangs te/ dang po yi ge de nas lhar bskyed nas bzlas pas bskul ba'i bar sngar bzhin/ gzhon nu ma'i ston mo bya/ 'dir brda dbang bskur/ de nas dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bzhin tshogs las bya ste/ lhag ma btang dge ba bsngo/ 'bring lha bdun ma ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa nas/ ya mi ni dang skrag byed ma// nags tshal ma dang de bzhin 'jigs// gzugs kun spyod ma mdzes ma dag /bha sur mkha' 'gro ma rnams bdun// zhes dang*/ gzugs can ma dang tsumbhi ka /lā ma yongs bsgyur byis bcas mo// mi ldog e hi ka lha mo// mkha' 'gro ma rnams bdun du bshad// ces gsungs pa ste/ stong pa nyid las chos 'byung bsnol ma/ lte bar baṃ/ zur drug oṃ baṃ sogs go cha'i sngags/ gzhan sngar bzhin la/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag gru mo'i kha ṭāṃ ga brten pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i cod pan dang*/ rlon pa man sngar dang 'dra/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i 'od zer can/ mdun du phag mo dmar mo/ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ sreg byed ma ser mo/ skrag byed ma ljang khu/

tsaṇḍi ka dud kha thams cad phyag g.yas man 'dra/ bzlas pa'i spro bsdu la dmigs/ sngags nye snying*/ go cha'i/ bsdus pa lhan skyes ma ni/ tshad med pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dbus su baṃ mtha' ma/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ g.yas skor dmar hraṃ me ba de'i 'od zer gyis rang gi lus dag nas/ bhan dhū dzi wa ka'i nas 'od zer can zhes pa'i bar snga ma bzhin bskyed/ slar snying ga'i sngags 'phreng de'i 'od zer gyis/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadag dang gnyis su med par bsams te 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa de gsal bar bsgom/ de nas sngags 'phreng gis snod kyi 'jig rten bzhu/ bcud la thim/ de bdag la/ de yas mas zhu snying ga'i sngags 'phreng*/ de baṃ/ de yal nas 'od gsal ba yang dag pa'i mtha' la 'jug de nas skad cig la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sngar lta bu/ chu las nya ldang gi tshul du langs/ yang sngar bzhin bsgom pa yang yang bya/ lha'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng gi 'od zer gyi sna la bcom ldan 'das ma bzhugs pas 'jigs rten thams cad khyab/ sems can thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang du bkod/ slar bsdus par bsam la snying po bzla/ gnyis pa zab mo brda'i dbang bskur ba ni smin grol sems kyi rgya mdud bshig pa ste/ slob dpon nus pa dang ldan par gyur nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phyir slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ sa ma ya aḥzhes zla ba nya gang ba/ su ra ste sa ma ya st+waṃ badzra siddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ de'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig bsgom du gzhug la byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ slob mas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/

smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol bdud rtsi lta bus/ rin po che lta bus/ de nas lus gnad bcas la sdod du bcug bcom ldan 'das mar bskyed/ bla ma dang sindhu ra'i lha tshogs rnams kyi smin mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku bsdus te slob ma'i lus la thim pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ de nas slob ma'i mgrin par a las padma dmar po/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung thams cad bsdus/ slob ma'i ngag la thim pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ de nas slob ma'i snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs thams cad bsdus te slob ma'i yid la thim pas yid kyi sgrib pa dag thugs rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa gyis byas la/ gsum ka la ka pā la'i bdud rtsi/ rje btsun mgon ni bdud rtsi dngos// bdud rtsi rje btsun mgon rang bzhin// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// su bsten grol bar 'gyur ro kye// he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma// zhes brjod de bdud rtsi byin/ de nas byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags 'byung na/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba yin pas de la dbang bskur bya'o// dbang po gang dang gang lam gyur// de dang de yi rang bzhin 'gro// mchog tu mnyam bzhag sbyor ba yis// thams cad sangs rgyas rang bzhin 'gyur// zhes pas thod pa lag pa g.yas su/ 'phreng ba'am mda' gzhu g.yon du/ sna tshogs rdo rje snying gar/ nor bu spyi bor bzhag ste phag zhal gtad/ dam tshig thod pa zhes byar brjod// mdzes pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ste// de kho na nyid dbu rgyan ming*// gtsug gi nor bu dbang bskur te// sangs rgyas zhes bya rjes gnang yin// he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba'o// de yang thod pas dbang po thams cad sgrib pa med pas rdo rje/

'phreng ba gzhom du med pa'i sgra snyan dril bu/ sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i sku phyag chen/ nor bu he ru ka'i brtul zhugs/ phag zhal rjes gnang du rig na bum pa'i dbang thob pa'o// thod pa la 'phreng ba dang sna tshogs rdo rje bkod/ phag zhal de'i khar nor bu de'i mthar 'og tu bkod de/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad kyis bstan/ de nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi blud/ thod pa lus zhes bya ba ste// rkang pa 'phreng ba'i ming can yin// dbu rgyan bha ga zhes byar brjod// sangs rgyas khu ba zhes brjod de// gtsug gi nor bu bde bar bshad// rdo rje pad ma'i dbang bskur ba'o// thod pa lus dkyil/ phreng ba liṅga/ sna tshogs rdo rje bha ga phag zhal de'i khu ba myang ba/ nor bu de las byung ba'i bde bar rtogs na gsang ba'i dbang rdzogs pa'o// thod pa la 'phreng ba bkod/ de'i khar sna tshogs rdo rje bzhag phag zhal dang nor bu de'i mthar bkod de/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad kyis bstan/ thod pa dbang gnyis de tshigs te// 'phreng ba sngags kyi bdag por brjod// bcu drug thig le thig btab pa'i// stong pa dbu rgyan zhes byar bshad// a la sogs pa'i ma mo rnams// sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra ru 'gyur// de rnams dbus kyi bde ba gang*// de ni gtsug gi nor bur brjod// rigs rnams kun gyi thams cad du/ rtag tu dbang bskur de lta bu// thod pa dbang po gnyis/ 'phreng bas de byin gyis brlabs te hūm̐ phaṭ kyi don bya ba/ sna tshogs rdo rjes zhu ba'i thig le bcu drug phag zhal gyi de la stong pas rgyas btab pa/ nor bus de las lhan skyes rtogs par go na dbang gsum pa'o// phyag rgya de thams cad bsdams te/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad kyis/ slob ma'i lte bar bzhag padma lte ba'i 'khor lo te/ nags sogs a ni ma mo yin// rtsa ba thar pa ster byed pa// brda yi sangs rgyas phyag rgya yin// de thams cad gnyis su mi phyed pa lte bar gnas pa a yig phyag chen du rtogs na dbang bzhi pa thob par 'gyur ba yin no// de'i dam tshig rang sems me long la blta bar bya'o// de'i phyir brda 'di dag dbang so so'i brdar bstan pas brda' bzhir song ba yin no// zhes mkha' 'gro mas rgyud sde'i gsang ba byin pas/

rdo rje sems dpa'i gseb lam rnam par 'byed pa la 'jigs pa med pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i padma dkar pos sbyar ba ste/ rje btsun gong ma'i phyag bzhes lhad med pa 'di kha'o zhes mkha' 'gro mas gsungs so// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
